text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho has finally arrived. Nice
Nature is
more nervous than ever before,
as she will face
Токай Тейо
head-to-head.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However... just before the start of the
race, Nice
Nature learns that Токай Тэйо
has been injured
and must withdraw from
the Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her entire reason for participating in the
Kikuka
Sho now gone, Найс Нэйчер
becomes distraught
and unfocused.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After I have a word with her, Nice
Nature
manages to regain her composure
and steps out
onto the track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
